## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem, the change and a small before/after example.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their outcomes. Identify checks that were not run and why. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md), [SUPPORT.md](../SUPPORT.md) and the [CI workflow](workflows/ci.yml).

## Research and data impact

Include the backend, seed, event order, instrument settings, fee/latency assumptions, and data capability flags. Prefer the saved public-depth fixture or a minimal synthetic sequence. Separate observed market events from modeled fills, fees and queue assumptions.

State whether results, data provenance, evaluation assumptions or public artifacts change. If they do, include reproducible evidence and distinguish old and new outputs.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and documented.
- [ ] Relevant checks were run, with outcomes recorded above.
- [ ] Credentials, identifying records and confidential or licensed data are excluded.
- [ ] Claims match implemented behavior and the evidence supplied.
